messages.text:
You are working on Handy Android (multi-module Gradle: :core,
:android-runtime, :app).

Goal:
1) Sync docs with the current code so all later prompts can rely on
   accurate baselines.
2) Land CI + device matrix scaffolding.

Files to touch:
- README.md (rewrite the "current state" list to reflect that
  OverlayChatPipeline and ChatViewModel both build TurnScreenContext
  via ScreenContextBuilder; explicitly list residual gaps: markId not
  preserved into TapTarget, MediaProjection unwired, action consent
  UI missing, debug candidates unredacted, capture is window-blind).
- (new) docs/DEVICE_MATRIX.md (Pixel/Samsung/OEM × API 26/29/30/33/34/36
  × gesture-nav/3-button × Hindi locale × TalkBack on/off × large
  display × split screen × foldable). Seed with at least the two cells
  you can test now; rest stay "TBD".
- (new) .github/workflows/ci.yml (gradle test, lint, detekt, release
  build, dependency vulnerability scan; ban screenshots in crash logs
  via a custom Konsist/Detekt rule or regex grep).
- DEBUG_LOG.md (append DL entry).

Do NOT:
- Change any production code logic.
- Touch the LLM prompts.

Tests:
- ./gradlew check (after CI lands, must be green).

Acceptance:
- README "current state" no longer contains the false claim that main
  chat send paths pass capture=null/screenText=null.
- CI runs on PRs.
- DEVICE_MATRIX.md exists.
I’ll sync the docs and CI scaffolding without touching runtime logic or prompts. I’m going to inspect the repo shape and existing Gradle tasks first so the workflow matches what’s actually here.

The search confirms the key code path is already in place: both `ChatViewModel` and `OverlayChatPipeline` inject `ScreenContextBuilder`. I’m narrowing now on the docs plus what Gradle tasks/plugins actually exist so the CI file doesn’t pretend to run phantom tasks.

There isn’t a Detekt plugin configured in Gradle yet, so I’m treating the workflow as scaffolding that calls it when present and emits a loud CI warning while the plugin lands later. The screenshot/crash-log ban can be enforced now with a regex guard in the workflow, which fits the files-only constraint.

Local Gradle can’t see a Java runtime by default, but the repo history points at the cached Adoptium 17 toolchain path. I’ll use that explicit `JAVA_HOME` for any Gradle verification so we’re testing the same way previous DL entries did.

The Gradle task list shows `test`, `lint`, `check`, and `:app:assembleRelease` are real; Detekt and a Gradle vulnerability plugin are not installed yet. I’m going to document that honestly in CI scaffolding while still enforcing the parts available today.

I found existing unrelated workspace changes (`HANDY_NEXT_LEVEL_PLAN.md` and `handy_macos_ref/`), so I’ll leave those alone. Next I’m editing only the four requested targets: README, device matrix doc, workflow YAML, and the new DL entry.

For the device matrix seed, the only installed/running emulator is a Pixel 9 Pro AVD on API 35, which is outside the requested release API set. I’m still going to seed two honest local smoke cells from it and mark the release-target Pixel/Samsung/OEM × API rows as `TBD` until those images/devices exist.

I’m making the docs say the slightly uncomfortable truth: screen context is wired for the main surfaces now, but the remaining action/capture/privacy gaps are still real and named. The CI YAML will be PR-triggered, with today’s enforceable checks plus explicit placeholders where Gradle plugins are not yet present.
The requested files are now edited. I’m doing a quick readback and local guard check before running the Gradle verification so I can catch formatting or CI-script mistakes while they’re still cheap.

The README no longer contains the stale `capture = null` / `screenText = null` claim, and the regex guard passes locally against Kotlin sources. I’m kicking off `./gradlew check` now with the cached JDK 17 path.

`./gradlew check` is not green: it fails in existing production lint before it reaches anything caused by the docs/CI edit. The first blocker is `android-runtime/src/main/kotlin/com/handy/runtime/llm/ClaudeLlmClient.kt:327` (`MissingPermission` on `ConnectivityManager.getActiveNetwork`); I’m reading the lint report so I can record the validation accurately without changing production code.

Unit tests are green (`./gradlew test` passed). The full `check` failure is limited to existing Android lint errors in runtime code, so I’m updating the DL validation row to say that plainly instead of leaving it as pending.

I’ve confirmed the new workflow YAML parses and the device matrix file is present. Since the CI includes a release build, I’m also running `:app:assembleRelease` separately; `check` is blocked by existing lint, but this verifies the other expensive CI leg.

The release build leg also exposes an existing blocker: R8 fails because Tink references missing `com.google.errorprone.annotations.*` classes. I’m recording that in the validation note too, because the new CI would correctly catch it.

Implemented the requested docs/CI scaffold without touching production code or LLM prompts.

Updated:
- [README.md](/Users/satvik.bansal/Desktop/Handy.android/HandyV2/README.md:40) now reflects `ChatViewModel` and `OverlayChatPipeline` both using `ScreenContextBuilder`, and lists the residual gaps you named.
- [docs/DEVICE_MATRIX.md](/Users/satvik.bansal/Desktop/Handy.android/HandyV2/docs/DEVICE_MATRIX.md:1) exists with required Pixel/Samsung/OEM × API targets and two locally verified Pixel API 35 smoke cells.
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](/Users/satvik.bansal/Desktop/Handy.android/HandyV2/.github/workflows/ci.yml:3) runs on PRs, with tests, lint, Detekt scaffold, release build, dependency review, and screenshot-payload log grep.
- [DEBUG_LOG.md](/Users/satvik.bansal/Desktop/Handy.android/HandyV2/DEBUG_LOG.md:813) has DL-049 appended.

Verification:
- README no longer contains the stale `capture = null` / `screenText = null` claim.
- Screenshot crash-log regex guard passed locally.
- `./gradlew test` passed.
- `./gradlew check` is not green yet because of existing runtime lint errors in `ClaudeLlmClient.kt` and `ScreenCapturePipeline.kt`.
- `:app:assembleRelease` also exposes an existing R8 blocker: missing `com.google.errorprone.annotations.*` classes referenced through Tink.

I left the pre-existing workspace changes in `HANDY_NEXT_LEVEL_PLAN.md` and `handy_macos_ref/` untouched.
